source_claim: Futabasha's official series character introduction identifies Kanna, Shouta Magatsuchi, Riko Saikawa, and Makoto Takiya as characters in Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon. The official anime portal's June 5, 2021 announcement adds Aida Taketo to its character introductions and previews his visual; an official Season 2 staff interview independently discusses Taketo as a new character and his design.
notes: Additional official sources for the roster evidence: https://maidragon.jp/news/archives/912 explicitly adds Aida Taketo to the character introductions; https://maidragon.jp/2nd/special/interview/ identifies Taketo as a new Season 2 character and discusses the production/design of Taketo and his grandmother. Futabasha's introduction at source_url individually identifies Kanna, Shouta Magatsuchi, Riko Saikawa, and Makoto Takiya. Only the five exact campaign members are proposed.
